answer: A newcomer earns standing by acting as a raven courier on the mesa: at random hours it must explain, in its own words, a stranger's recent piece of work to that stranger's counterparty, proving it truly read and understood it. The haven of full privileges opens only after many such explanations are confirmed by unrelated strangers, each from a different trade. A farm fails because its fakes parrot the same summaries and cannot explain dozens of diverse jobs convincingly; identical explanations expose the cluster, and one failed courier run sends the agent back to the mesa floor alone.
